layout_and_structure.max_width: max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen bg-[#FFF6E8] relative flex flex-col pb-24 md:max-w-4xl

header.logo_mark: gold circle (#F5B82E) with 8-ray maroon (#7A1410) firework burst icon

category_chips.active_state: bg-[#7A1410] text-[#FFF6E8] rounded-full px-4 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold
category_chips.inactive_state: bg-[#F3E2CC] text-[#2B1712] rounded-full px-4 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium hover:bg-[#EBD8BF]

product_card.badge: stock remaining badge e.g. '4 left' in #D13A1F bg red tint or text
product_card.stepper: quantity add/subtract button with count in gold/maroon buttons

sticky_cart_bar.position: fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 max-w-md mx-auto z-40 p-3 bg-[#7A1410] text-[#FFF6E8] flex justify-between items-center rounded-t-2xl shadow-xl

key_features_and_flows.catalog: Product listing with live instant search, category filter chips, stock badges, retail vs wholesale tier prices, instant quantity increment/decrement.
key_features_and_flows.cart_drawer_page: Itemized list with quantity controls, Subtotal, CGST 9%, SGST 9%, Round off calculation, and Grand Total display.
key_features_and_flows.checkout_page: Payment method tabs (Cash, UPI, Card), Mock UPI QR Code generator/image with UTR transaction input, and 'Payment Received' instant order submit button.
key_features_and_flows.order_receipt: Thermal 80mm printable style invoice dialog/view with HSN codes, GST summary breakdown, delivery status, and safety warning notes.
key_features_and_flows.auth_pages: Login & Signup with Retail vs Wholesale toggle, wholesale approval pending notice, GSTIN (optional), and business profile saved state.

testing_guidelines.data_testid_convention: All key buttons, inputs, category chips, cart items, price totals, and nav items MUST include data-testid in kebab-case format.

instructions_to_main_agent: Load Google Fonts link for DM Sans and Bricolage Grotesque in index.html or App.js.
Maintain the exact palette: background #FFF6E8, header/sidebar #7A1410, accent red #D13A1F, gold #F5B82E, text #2B1712, muted text #6B5148, borders #EBD8BF, chips #F3E2CC.
Use standard JS/JSX format for component files inside frontend/src/.
Ensure retail vs wholesale prices update dynamically based on user role status.
Include mock payment flow with UPI QR code rendering, UTR input, and instant receipt generation.
Apply data-testid to all interactive components as outlined in the testing guidelines.
